```yaml
name: Replay Benchmark

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 0'  # Runs every Sunday at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pre-commit

      - name: Run environment check
        run: python check_env.py --auto-install

      - name: Run pre-commit checks
        run: pre-commit run --files README.md .github/workflows/bench.yml docs/bench_history.csv scripts/run_replay_bench.py

      - name: Run replay benchmark
        run: python scripts/run_replay_bench.py

      - name: Commit benchmark results
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          if git diff --quiet docs/bench_history.csv; then
            echo "No changes to bench_history.csv"
          else
            git add docs/bench_history.csv
            git commit -m "Update benchmark history [skip ci]"
            git push
          fi
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
